import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def task_func(df, target_values=[1, 3, 4]):
    """
    Replace values in each DataFrame column that are not in target_values with 0,
    then plot the distribution of each column after replacement.

    Returns
    -------
    matplotlib.axes.Axes
        The Axes object of the plotted data.
    """
    df_replaced = df.copy()

    for col in df_replaced.columns:
        df_replaced[col] = df_replaced[col].where(df_replaced[col].isin(target_values), 0)

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))

    for col in df_replaced.columns:
        sns.histplot(
            df_replaced[col],
            discrete=True,
            stat="count",
            element="step",
            fill=False,
            ax=ax,
            label=str(col),
        )

    ax.set_xlabel("Value")
    ax.set_ylabel("Count")
    ax.set_title("Column distributions after replacement")
    ax.legend(title="Column")

    plt.tight_layout()
    return ax
